[LTIM.7.1] `t.floor(d: Duration) → Time`, a member of `Time`
([LGRA.9.6.2]), returns the latest boundary of `d` at or before `t`. The
boundaries are the multiples of `d` counted from 1970-01-01T00:00 at `t`'s
offset ([LTIM.1.1.1]), so the result's `utc_ns` is
`utc_ns - floor_mod(utc_ns + tz_offset_ns, d)`, and an instant on a boundary
floors to itself. The result keeps `t`'s `tz_offset_ns`.

`floor` to `0_s` has no boundary: it is a ComputationError of kind
DIVIDE_BY_ZERO ([LEXP.7.15.1]). A negative `d` cannot be formed
([LTIM.1.3.1]). A result before the first representable instant is
NOT_REPRESENTABLE ([LTIM.1.1.5]).
